title: SpeakingDecision
description: Calibrated per-face speaking decision from Gemini Decisions API (gemini-decision-1) or FB6 fallback.

window_t0.description: Start of the 1 s evaluated window (Unix milliseconds).

window_t1.description: End of the 1 s evaluated window (Unix milliseconds).

p_speaking.description: Calibrated probability that this face is speaking during [window_t0, window_t1].

calibrated.description: True for Decisions API output; false when FB6 MediaPipe mouth-open fallback is used.

source.description: Source that produced this speaking probability.
